| Field     | Findings                  | `field.review-round.findings`       | text optional                          | One line for each finding: its class of problem, named the same in every round of the task; its weight, important or nit; whether it is of this change or was there before; and the test that holds its fix, once fixed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Relation  | Runs                      | `edge.review-round.runs`            | refs ent.manual-run optional           | The records of the verdicts the round gave, by file name.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Derived   | Next round                | `derived.next-round`                |                                        | What follows the last round of a step of a task, from its records: a clean round, with no finding of the change, ends the step; within the ceiling, another round of the step; past it, another full round while each finds fewer findings of the change than the one before, counted by class, and each is fixable within the task, up to six full rounds of the step in all; when that stops and every finding of the last round is fixed with a test, a narrow round on the fixes, again while each narrow round finds fewer than the one before and every one of its findings is fixed with a test, up to three; otherwise a question to the owner. |
| Derived   | Step payoff               | `derived.step-payoff`               |                                        | For each step, over its applications, once there are ten: the rounds, the tokens that are known, with for how many rounds each count is known, and the findings of the change by weight; an application is one step of one task, its rounds taken together. A step whose applications found nothing is a candidate to simplify, which the owner decides; the tool removes nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      |
| Rule      | Round ceilings            | `rule.round-ceilings`               |                                        | A task sets two ceilings of review rounds, one for the review of its statement and one for the review of its result, each counted on its own; the approach sets no number for them.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Rule      | Whole class               | `rule.whole-class`                  |                                        | A reviewer who finds a problem looks for it across its whole class of problem, not only where it showed.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |
| Rule      | Rounds converge           | `rule.rounds-converge`              |                                        | Past its ceiling, a step goes on while its rounds converge and stops when they do not, as derived.next-round says; six full rounds and three narrow ones are the approach's numbers, which a project changes by a process entry that overrides this rule.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Ready after a clean round | `rule.ready-after-clean-round`      |                                        | A change is ready to merge after a clean round of the review of its result; who allows a merge, a publication or the cost of more rounds is the policy of the project's owner, which the approach requires to be followed and does not set.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Rule      | Round recorded            | `rule.round-recorded`               |                                        | Where the configuration sets reviewRounds, every round of review is recorded, with what is known of its cost and every finding.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Invariant | Rounds well formed        | `inv.review-rounds-well-formed`     |                                        | Every record gives once each a task, a known step, a number, a real time in UTC and an author, its numbers are whole and not negative, every finding line gives a class, a weight and whether it is of the change, and no two records give the same task, step, narrowness and number.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                             | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                       | WHEN                                       | THEN                                                                                                                             | Proof  |
| -------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.review-round.malformed`         | `inv.review-rounds-well-formed`, `ent.review-round`  | records of rounds without a task, with the step `final`, with the time `2026-99-99T99:99:99Z`, with a negative count, with a finding line that gives no weight, and two with the same task, step and number | the check runs                             | it names each record and what is wrong, and fails                                                                                | auto   |
| `check.review-round.within-ceiling`    | `derived.next-round`, `rule.round-ceilings`          | a task whose first review of the result, ceiling 3, found two findings of the change                                                                                                                        | the rounds are read                        | the next is round 2 of the review of the result                                                                                  | auto   |
| `check.review-round.converging`        | `derived.next-round`, `rule.rounds-converge`         | three rounds of the review of a result, ceiling 3, found 3, 2 and 1 finding of the change, each fixable                                                                                                     | the rounds are read                        | the next is a fourth full round; with 3, 2 and 2 it is a narrow round when the last two are fixed with a test                    | auto   |
| `check.review-round.six-in-all`        | `derived.next-round`, `rule.rounds-converge`         | six full rounds of a step that found 6, 5, 4, 3, 2 and 1 finding, the last fixed with a test, with a ceiling of 1 and of 7                                                                                  | the rounds are read                        | the next is a narrow round, not a seventh full one                                                                               | auto   |
| `check.review-round.narrow-needs-test` | `derived.next-round`, `rule.rounds-converge`         | a narrow round that found fewer findings than the round before, one of them without a test that holds its fix                                                                                               | the rounds are read                        | the next is a question to the owner                                                                                              | auto   |
| `check.review-round.narrow-three`      | `derived.next-round`, `rule.rounds-converge`         | three narrow rounds that found 3, 2 and 1 finding, each fixed with a test                                                                                                                                   | the rounds are read                        | the next is a question to the owner                                                                                              | auto   |
| `check.review-round.not-fixable`       | `derived.next-round`                                 | a round within the ceiling, and one past it with fewer findings than the one before, each with a finding not fixable within the task                                                                        | the rounds are read                        | the next is a question to the owner                                                                                              | auto   |
| `check.review-round.clean-ends`        | `derived.next-round`, `rule.ready-after-clean-round` | a round of the review of a result whose only finding was there before the change                                                                                                                            | the rounds are read                        | the step has ended clean                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.review-round.payoff-after-ten`  | `derived.step-payoff`                                | nine tasks with one review of the statement each, then a tenth with three rounds of it                                                                                                                      | `--rounds` runs before and after the tenth | before, no payoff is printed; after, the step has ten applications, not twelve, with their rounds, tokens and findings by weight | auto   |
| `check.review-round.whole-class`       | `rule.whole-class`                                   | a finding of a round of review                                                                                                                                                                              | a reviewer reads the report                | the report says where else the same class of problem was looked for                                                              | manual |
| `check.review-round.ceilings-set`      | `rule.round-ceilings`                                | a task whose result is reviewed                                                                                                                                                                             | a reviewer reads its statement             | it names a ceiling for the review of the statement and one for the review of the result                                          | manual |
| `check.review-round.ready-after-clean` | `rule.ready-after-clean-round`                       | a change about to be merged                                                                                                                                                                                 | a reviewer reads its rounds                | its last round of the review of the result is clean, and the merge is one the owner's policy allows                              | manual |
| `check.review-round.recorded`          | `rule.round-recorded`                                | a change reviewed in a project that sets `reviewRounds`                                                                                                                                                     | a reviewer reads the directory             | every round of its review has a record, with the tokens that are known and every finding                                         | manual |

## Test

| Kind      | Term                | ID                              | Type               | Definition                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | ------------------- | ------------------------------- | ------------------ | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Test                | `ent.test`                      |                    | Code that implements checks and starts its title with their IDs.                                                                                                                      |
| Relation  | Implements          | `edge.test.checks`              | refs ent.check     | The checks the test implements.                                                                                                                                                       |
| Relation  | In suite            | `edge.test.suite`               | ref ent.test-suite | The suite the test belongs to.                                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule      | Broken input        | `rule.validator-test-breaks`    |                    | A test of a check that a validator holds, a program that refuses bad files or data, gives it an input that passes and one broken in that check's way, and expects that check's error. |
| Invariant | Known checks        | `inv.test-names-known-checks`   |                    | A test names only checks the catalogue has.                                                                                                                                           |
| Invariant | Only what is built  | `inv.test-only-implemented`     |                    | A test proves only concepts that are implemented.                                                                                                                                     |
| Invariant | Manual stays manual | `inv.no-manual-tested`          |                    | No test implements a manual check.                                                                                                                                                    |
| Invariant | Does what it says   | `inv.test-does-what-check-says` |                    | A test does what the check it names says.                                                                                                                                             |

| Check                          | Concepts                        | GIVEN                                                                    | WHEN                               | THEN                                                                                                                | Proof  |
| ------------------------------ | ------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.test.unknown-check`     | `inv.test-names-known-checks`   | a test names a check the catalogue does not have                         | the check runs                     | it names the check and the suite, and fails                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.test.proves-unbuilt`    | `inv.test-only-implemented`     | a test names a concept, or a check of a concept, that is not implemented | the check runs                     | it names it and fails                                                                                               | auto   |
| `check.test.tags-manual`       | `inv.no-manual-tested`          | a test names a manual check                                              | the check runs                     | it names the check and fails                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.test.does-what-it-says` | `inv.test-does-what-check-says` | a tagged test                                                            | a reviewer reads it with its check | it sets up GIVEN, does WHEN and asserts THEN                                                                        | manual |
| `check.test.validator-breaks`  | `rule.validator-test-breaks`    | a test of a check that a validator holds                                 | a reviewer reads it with its check | it runs the validator on an input that passes and on one broken in that check's way, and asserts that check's error | manual |

## Test suite

| Kind      | Term                  | ID                            | Type                    | Definition                                                                                        |
| --------- | --------------------- | ----------------------------- | ----------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Test suite            | `ent.test-suite`              |                         | A kind of test the team runs, such as unit or end-to-end, and the classes it must prove.          |
| Field     | Name                  | `field.test-suite.name`       | text                    | Unique among the suites.                                                                          |
| Field     | Covers                | `field.test-suite.cover`      | text                    | The classes whose implemented concepts the suite must prove.                                      |
| Relation  | Checks                | `edge.test-suite.checks`      | refs ent.check optional | Checks the suite must implement, such as a key scenario end to end or the checks a judge decides. |
| Invariant | Unique names          | `inv.suite-names-unique`      |                         | No two suites share a name.                                                                       |
| Invariant | Not empty             | `inv.suite-not-empty`         |                         | Every suite has test files.                                                                       |
| Invariant | Covers its classes    | `inv.suite-covers-classes`    |                         | Every implemented concept of a covered class is proven by a test of the suite.                    |
| Invariant | Implements its checks | `inv.suite-implements-checks` |                         | Every check a suite names, of implemented concepts, is implemented by a test of that suite.       |

| Check                                  | Concepts                                                | GIVEN                                                                                    | WHEN           | THEN                                          | Proof |
| -------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | --------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `check.test-suite.uncovered-concept`   | `inv.suite-covers-classes`                              | an implemented invariant has no test in the unit suite                                   | the check runs | it names the concept and the suite, and fails | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.unimplemented-check` | `inv.suite-implements-checks`, `edge.test-suite.checks` | the end-to-end suite names `check.loan.renew-twice`, and none of its tests implements it | the check runs | it names the check and the suite, and fails   | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.duplicate-name`      | `inv.suite-names-unique`                                | two suites are named unit                                                                | the check runs | it names the suite and fails                  | auto  |
| `check.test-suite.empty`               | `inv.suite-not-empty`                                   | a suite's directory has no test files                                                    | the check runs | it names the suite and fails                  | auto  |

## Ticket

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                             | Type                     | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ------------------------------ | ------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Ticket                 | `ent.ticket`                   |                          | A slice of the gap: what to build now, within which limits.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Why now                | `field.ticket.why-now`         | text                     | Why this slice comes before the rest of the gap.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Field     | Out of scope           | `field.ticket.out-of-scope`    | text optional            | What not to build, though it is target too.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Field     | Pre-authorized         | `field.ticket.pre-authorized`  | text optional            | Permissions the agent would otherwise stop and ask for.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Relation  | Slice                  | `edge.ticket.concepts`         | refs ent.concept         | The concepts to build.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Relation  | Checks                 | `edge.ticket.checks`           | refs ent.check optional  | The checks of the slice, on the ticket's Checks: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Relation  | Depends on             | `edge.ticket.depends-on`       | refs ent.ticket optional | Slices that must be done first.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Derived   | Gap                    | `derived.gap`                  |                          | The work left: target concepts with their checks, automatic checks without a test, known divergences.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Derived   | Slice done             | `derived.slice-done`           |                          | Nothing of the slice left: its concepts implemented, its automatic checks tested, none of the checks it lists waiting for a concept outside it, and no known divergence that names only its concepts.                                                                                                                                   |
| Derived   | Readiness              | `derived.readiness`            |                          | What a target concept waits for: a ticket that takes it, an accepted deferral in force that names it, the owner while only tentative entries name it or an accepted entry naming it names a tentative one, or another target that its definition row or one of its checks names; otherwise it is ready. --gap shows it for each target. |
| Derived   | Next slice             | `derived.next-slice`           |                          | What --next proposes for the next ticket: the ready targets of the first ontology section that has any, the ready targets they depend on, and the checks whose concepts the slice and the code cover.                                                                                                                                   |
| Rule      | No behavior in tickets | `rule.ticket-without-behavior` |                          | A ticket does not describe behavior; behavior is in the check catalogue, written before the ticket.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Rule      | Build what is ready    | `rule.take-ready`              |                          | Work is taken from what --gap marks ready, through a ticket; a target that waits for the owner, a condition or another target is not built ahead of it.                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | Cut when started       | `rule.cut-when-started`        |                          | A ticket is cut when work on its slice starts, not ahead of it, because it takes its concepts out of what --next offers; an agent may cut it from --next, and what the agent may do then is the owner's choice                                                                                                                          |
| Rule      | Closed when done       | `rule.ticket-closed-on-done`   |                          | When --gap with the ticket prints SLICE_DONE and the tests pass, the ticket is closed and kept as the record of the slice                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Coordinator cuts       | `rule.coordinator-cuts`        |                          | When several agents work at once, one coordinator cuts all their tickets and commits them to the main branch before they start, since a ticket on another branch takes nothing that the others can see                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | One change per slice   | `rule.slice-one-change`        |                          | A slice is one change that a reviewer can read with its own evidence; when what --next proposes is more, it is split along its dependencies and the part the rest depends on is built first                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | Names its concepts     | `inv.ticket-has-ids`           |                          | A ticket has an IDs: line.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Invariant | Related checks         | `inv.ticket-checks-related`    |                          | Every check a ticket lists exists and names one of its concepts.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Action    | Cut a slice            | `action.cut-slice`             |                          | Take part of the gap and write the ticket with its limits and permissions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |

| Check                             | Concepts                                        | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | WHEN                                              | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Proof  |
| --------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ | ------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.ticket.no-ids`             | `inv.ticket-has-ids`                            | a ticket has no `IDs:` line                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | the check runs                                    | it names the ticket and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                            | auto   |
| `check.ticket.unknown-check`      | `inv.ticket-checks-related`                     | a ticket lists a check the catalogue does not have                                                                                                                                                                                               | the check runs                                    | it names the ticket and the check, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.ticket.unrelated-check`    | `inv.ticket-checks-related`                     | a ticket lists a check that names none of its concepts                                                                                                                                                                                           | the check runs                                    | it names the ticket and the check, and fails                                                                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.ticket.slice-open`         | `derived.slice-done`, `derived.gap`             | a ticket whose concepts are not built                                                                                                                                                                                                            | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it lists them with their checks, prints `SLICE_OPEN` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                                         | auto   |
| `check.ticket.slice-done`         | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested, with no divergence of its own                                                                                                                                                     | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it prints `SLICE_DONE` and exits 0                                                                                                                                                                                                       | auto   |
| `check.ticket.own-divergence`     | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested, and a known divergence that names only its concepts                                                                                                                               | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it shows the divergence, prints `SLICE_OPEN: 1` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                                              | auto   |
| `check.ticket.shared-divergence`  | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built and whose checks are tested, and a known divergence that names one of its concepts and one outside it                                                                                                          | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it shows the divergence apart, does not count it, and prints `SLICE_DONE`                                                                                                                                                                | auto   |
| `check.ticket.check-waits`        | `derived.slice-done`                            | a ticket whose concepts are built lists a check that also needs a concept outside the slice, not built yet                                                                                                                                       | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it names the check and the concept it waits for, prints `SLICE_OPEN: 1` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.ticket.judged-check-waits` | `derived.slice-done`, `inv.judged-check-tested` | a ticket whose concepts are built lists a judged check that also needs a concept outside the slice, not built yet                                                                                                                                | `--gap` runs with the ticket                      | it names the check and the concept it waits for, prints `SLICE_OPEN: 1` and exits 1                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.ticket.checks-line-only`   | `edge.ticket.checks`                            | a ticket names, under out of scope, a check that names none of its concepts                                                                                                                                                                      | the check runs, then `--gap` runs with the ticket | the check passes, and `--gap` neither shows nor counts that check                                                                                                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.ticket.gap-readiness`      | `derived.readiness`                             | `action.cancel-hold` is in no ticket and no entry names it, `rule.pickup-window` is in ticket 0003, a tentative entry names `hook.due-reminder`, an accepted deferral names `view.catalog`, and a check of `view.desk` also names `view.catalog` | `--gap` runs                                      | it marks them ready, in ticket 0003, waiting for the owner, deferred until the condition, and waiting for `view.catalog`                                                                                                                 | auto   |
| `check.ticket.next-slice`         | `derived.next-slice`                            | the example, whose first ready target is `action.set-borrow-limit` in the Member section                                                                                                                                                         | `--next` runs                                     | it prints `NEXT · Member` with `action.set-borrow-limit` on the IDs line and `check.member.set-borrow-limit` on the Checks line; with nothing ready, it says what the targets wait for, and with no target left, what else the gap holds | auto   |
| `check.ticket.no-behavior`        | `rule.ticket-without-behavior`                  | a ticket                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | a reviewer reads it                               | it lists concepts and checks; any behavior it needs is already in the catalogue                                                                                                                                                          | manual |
| `check.ticket.take-ready`         | `rule.take-ready`                               | an agent looks for work                                                                                                                                                                                                                          | it takes the next slice                           | the slice holds ready targets only, cut into a ticket from `--next`; a target that waits for the owner is left until the owner answers                                                                                                   | manual |
| `check.ticket.cut-when-started`   | `rule.cut-when-started`                         | the tickets open in a project                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | a reviewer reads them                             | each is being worked on now; none was cut ahead to hold concepts for later, and an agent that cut one did only what the owner allows                                                                                                     | manual |
| `check.ticket.closed-on-done`     | `rule.ticket-closed-on-done`                    | a ticket whose `--gap` prints `SLICE_DONE` and whose tests pass                                                                                                                                                                                  | a reviewer looks for it                           | it is closed, and its file or its tracker entry is still there                                                                                                                                                                           | manual |
| `check.ticket.coordinator-cuts`   | `rule.coordinator-cuts`                         | several agents start work at the same time, each on a branch of its own                                                                                                                                                                          | a reviewer reads the tickets they work from       | one coordinator cut them all, they were on the main branch before the agents started, and no concept is in two of them                                                                                                                   | manual |
| `check.ticket.one-change`         | `rule.slice-one-change`                         | a ticket cut from what `--next` proposed                                                                                                                                                                                                         | a reviewer reads the change that closes it        | it is one change the reviewer can follow with its tests; if not, the ticket should have been split along the dependencies, the part the rest depends on first                                                                            | manual |

## Agent rules

| Kind      | Term                             | ID                                  | Type                       | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| --------- | -------------------------------- | ----------------------------------- | -------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Agent rules                      | `ent.agent-rules`                   |                            | The section of the agents' instructions that says what else to update when something changes, and what to run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Field     | Files                            | `field.agent-rules.files`           | text                       | The files that hold the agents' instructions, listed in the configuration under agentInstructions; the check reads the IDs and entries they mention.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Relation  | Sources                          | `edge.agent-rules.sources`          | refs ent.decision optional | The entries the instructions name as the source of their rules.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Derived   | Checks to review                 | `derived.review-checks`             |                            | The manual checks a change touches: the project's checks whose concepts its definition rows, its checks, its code, its doc sections, its tickets or its files under a directory of reviewPaths touch, and the approach's checks for the kinds of artifact it changes; the approach's checks of a judge and of the screens only when the change touches a judge, a file of code that names it, its verdicts, a judged check, a view or a screen, or when a changed file is nothing the configuration describes; files under the directories of manualRuns and reviewRounds are the review's own records and touch nothing; --review <base> lists them. |
| Concept   | Approach IDs                     | `concept.approach-ids`              |                            | The approach's concept IDs, retired IDs and manual checks, generated into tools/ont-check/approach.json and copied with the tool, so that a project's check resolves the rules of the approach.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                       |
| Rule      | Short                            | `rule.agent-rules-short`            |                            | The section is short enough to be read at the start of every session.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| Rule      | Points at files                  | `rule.agent-rules-point-at-files`   |                            | Every row names a path or a command.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | Start from IDs                   | `rule.start-from-ids`               |                            | Every task starts by naming the IDs it touches; a task that cannot is not about meaning, or the ontology is incomplete.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Findings that matter             | `rule.findings-mislead`             |                            | A consistency review reports what would mislead a reader or an agent, or would break a check. Style, the completeness of lists and compliance that changes nothing are not findings.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Rule      | Every change committed           | `rule.commit-finished-work`         |                            | Every change ends with a commit of its own files; who approves a commit or a push is the user's choice.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Rule      | Rule names its source            | `rule.agent-rule-source`            |                            | A process rule in the agent instructions that comes from a rule of the approach or from a decision names that rule's ID or that entry; commands and matters of style name nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Rule      | Departure by entry               | `rule.departure-by-entry`           |                            | A project departs from a rule of the approach, stricter or looser, only by a process entry that extends or overrides it, and the instruction that departs cites that entry.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Strongest step                   | `rule.strongest-step`               |                            | A correction of an agent is held at the strongest step that can hold it: the structure of the code, so the mistake cannot be written; then a check of the tool, a test or a lint; then a rule in the agent instructions; a reviewer's memory last                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Rule      | Reviewed before merge            | `rule.reviewed-before-merge`        |                            | Before a change is merged, an agent of another provider that did not write it gives each of its checks to review a verdict: pass, fail, not run with the reason, or not applicable with the reason. A verdict counts while the stamp it was given at is the check's stamp now and the commits since change none of the files it read; the check of errors in code is given again on each new diff. A fail, or a finding of the change that remains, stops the merge; a not run with its reason does not stop it on its own.                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Value checked against its source | `rule.value-checked-against-source` |                            | In a project whose values carry a source, a change that adds or alters such a value is reviewed against the source: the reviewer opens it and gives the project's check of values against their source a verdict, recorded as a manual run.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                           |
| Rule      | Code reviewed for errors         | `rule.code-reviewed-for-errors`     |                            | The reviewer of a change that touches code reads the diff for errors of correctness and for security problems and gives the approach's check of them a verdict; a change that brings one of them fails it.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                            |
| Invariant | Instruction references resolve   | `inv.agent-rule-references-resolve` |                            | Every concept ID the agent instructions mention is defined, in the project's ontology or the approach's, and not retired; every entry they cite exists and is in force.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                               |
| Invariant | Approach IDs current             | `inv.approach-ids-current`          |                            | The generated approach IDs match the approach's ontology.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | Review paths known               | `inv.review-paths-known`            |                            | Every concept that the configuration names under reviewPaths is defined.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              |
| Invariant | Review path checked              | `inv.review-path-checked`           |                            | Every concept named under reviewPaths has a manual check in the project's catalogue, which a change of the directory's files hands to the reviewer.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Action    | Critique a change                | `action.critique-change`            |                            | Review a significant change as an agent that did not write it, from the diff and the IDs it touches, without the author's conclusions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                |

| ------------------------------------------------ | -------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----------------------------------------------------------------- | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |

| `check.agent-rules.findings-that-matter`         | `rule.findings-mislead`                                        | a consistency review of a project                                                                                                                         | a reviewer reads its findings                                     | each one says who would be misled or which check would break; style, list completeness and compliance that changes nothing are left out                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | manual |

| `check.agent-rules.review-catalogue-changed`     | `derived.review-checks`                                        | a row of the example's catalogue changes                                                                                                                  | `--review HEAD` runs                                              | it lists the approach's manual checks of the Check section, `check.check.product-terms` among them                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |

| Entity    | Ontology tree           | `ent.ontology-tree`               |                  | A page for people that shows the whole ontology as a tree: each entity with the rows of its table by kind, and a table without an entity under its heading. | Field     | Place                   | `field.ontology-tree.place`       | text optional    | Where a clone keeps its tree: a path in the clone's own Git configuration, ont.treeOut, never in ont.config.json, so that no path of one machine reaches the repository. Without it, no tree is refreshed and none is reported stale. A place inside the working tree of the repository, or a link that resolves into it, is refused with the reason and nothing is written there, so that a wrong setting never overwrites a file of the repository.                                                                  |
| Field     | Built from              | `field.ontology-tree.built-from`  | text             | What the page was written from, in its footer: the commit of HEAD, read once, marked +working-tree when a file the generator read is not that commit's file at the path it was asked for inside the repository, links not followed, or no-commit outside Git; the path of the configuration from the root of the repository, except outside Git; and the date.                                                                                                                                                         |
| Relation  | Concepts shown          | `edge.ontology-tree.concepts`     | refs ent.concept | The definition rows the tree shows.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    |
| Derived   | Stale tree              | `derived.tree-stale`              |                  | The tree at the place is stale when the file is missing or cannot be read, carries no mark of what it was built from or a mark without its commit, configuration or date, the mark is +working-tree or no-commit, its configuration is not the ont.config.json at the root, or its commit is not the branch main, refs/heads/main. It is reported and blocks nothing, a file that cannot be read included.                                                                                                             |
| Rule      | Only the structure      | `rule.tree-structure-only`        |                  | The tree follows the order of the tables and the configured order of kinds, then the other classes its rows have, as an external ontology's, shows each row by its term with its ID and definition on hover, the entity a field or relation refers to and the entities a view shows, and nothing else. The rows under an entity are its table, not kinds of it. The footer of the page says what it was built from, its commit, configuration and date, and is not part of the tree.                                   |
| Rule      | Refreshed after a merge | `rule.tree-refreshed-after-merge` |                  | After a merge into main in a clone that names a place, the protocol's hook writes the tree there from the ont.config.json at the root, when every file it reads equals that file in HEAD; otherwise it names the files that differ and writes nothing. On another branch, without a place, or after a squash merge it writes nothing, and an error of the generator does not undo the merge. A merge Git ends without the hook, such as a rebase or a resolved conflict, is refreshed by the same command run by hand. |
| Invariant | Whole ontology          | `inv.tree-complete`               |                  | Every definition row is in the tree exactly once, in the branch of its table.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                          |

## Formal form

| Kind      | Term                       | ID                               | Type            | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                 |
| --------- | -------------------------- | -------------------------------- | --------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- |
| Entity    | Formal form                | `ent.formal-form`                |                 | The behavior of a definition row in the form language: how a derived value or a rule is computed, what an invariant refuses, what an action or a hook does.                                                |
| Relation  | States                     | `edge.formal-form.concept`       | ref ent.concept | The row whose behavior the form states; the form starts with its ID.                                                                                                                                       |
