| Rule      | Not the product            | `rule.oracle-not-the-product`    |                 | The oracle checks the ontology and the code; it is never deployed or run as the product, whose code a model writes from the ontology.                                                                      |
| Rule      | Code compared              | `rule.code-compared-with-oracle` |                 | A project with an oracle runs its code and the oracle on the same random sequences of implemented actions; a difference fails unless it is a known divergence, and a run that compares nothing fails.      |
| Invariant | A form per row             | `inv.form-per-row`               |                 | When the configuration turns the oracle on, every derived, rule, invariant, hook and action row has a formal form.                                                                                         |
| Invariant | Forms name what is defined | `inv.form-names-defined`         |                 | Every name in a form is an ID that has a form, a field or relation of the entity it is read on, a parameter, a loop variable or a word of the language.                                                    |
| Invariant | Forms end                  | `inv.forms-end`                  |                 | No derived value, concept or rule value reads itself, and no rule or invariant names itself by refuse by, directly or through other forms.                                                                 |
| Invariant | Writes in type             | `inv.writes-in-type`             |                 | A value an action or a hook writes to a field is of the field's type, read as the contracts read it, and a relation names a record of its entity; a run that would write another stops and names the form. |
| Invariant | Code compared by a test    | `inv.code-compared`              |                 | When the oracle is on and an action is implemented, a file of systemTests registers the comparison with the oracle; what it compares is reviewed (rule.code-compared-with-oracle).                         |

| Check                                 | Concepts                                             | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                              | WHEN                                 | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                    | Proof  |
| ------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ | --------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ------ |
| `check.formal-form.missing`           | `inv.form-per-row`, `ent.formal-form`                | a project whose configuration turns the oracle on, with an action row that has no form in its section's behavior block                                                                                                                                                                                                             | the check runs                       | it names the row and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                              | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.unknown-name`      | `inv.form-names-defined`, `edge.formal-form.concept` | a form that reads a field its entity does not have, and one that calls a derived value that has no form                                                                                                                                                                                                                            | the check runs                       | it names both and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.unchecked-name`    | `inv.form-names-defined`                             | an unknown field in an invariant that no action names, in an invariant named only by another invariant, a field set on a value that is not a record, and an `always` inside a loop, where nothing would run it                                                                                                                     | the check runs                       | it names all four and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                             | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.cycle`             | `inv.forms-end`                                      | a derived value that reads itself, a rule whose value reads itself, and an invariant that names itself by `refuse by`                                                                                                                                                                                                              | the check runs                       | it names all three, each with the forms it goes through, and fails                                                                                                                                                                      | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.write-out-of-type` | `inv.writes-in-type`                                 | an action that sets an `integer 1..` field to 0, one that sets a `one of` field to a value not in the list, one that sets a `date optional` field to text or to a day not on the calendar, one that sets a `datetime` field with an offset of +99:99 or with no offset, and one that sets a relation to a record of another entity | the oracle runs them                 | each run stops and names the form, the field and its type                                                                                                                                                                               | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.out-of-order`      | `rule.form-follows-rows`                             | a block whose forms are not in the order of the rows, a form that starts with an ID of another section, and a block that is not folded                                                                                                                                                                                             | the check runs                       | it names each and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                 | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.not-the-product`   | `rule.oracle-not-the-product`, `concept.oracle`      | a change that adds or changes formal forms                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         | a reviewer reads it                  | nothing runs the oracle as the product, and the code is still written by a model from the ontology                                                                                                                                      | manual |
| `check.formal-form.code-compared`     | `rule.code-compared-with-oracle`                     | a project with an oracle and code                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | a reviewer reads its comparison test | it runs the code and the oracle on the same random sequences of implemented actions, fails on a difference that is not a known divergence with its condition, fails when nothing is compared, and keeps a failing sequence to repeat it | manual |
| `check.formal-form.compare-required`  | `inv.code-compared`                                  | the example, with the oracle on and actions built, without its comparison test, then with a file that names the oracle, the check's tag or compareTest only in a comment                                                                                                                                                           | the check runs                       | each time it says no test of systemTests registers the comparison, and fails; with the registered test it passes                                                                                                                        | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.mutation-survives` | `derived.surviving-mutation`                         | the example's forms, where its catalogue holds the borrow limit at five loans but not whether a member at the limit may still borrow                                                                                                                                                                                               | `--mutate` runs                      | it lists `refuse when open > limit → refuse when open >= limit` among the changes no trace fails on, as information, and passes; a one-line form, `rule.loan-period = 21 days`, is changed too                                          | auto   |
| `check.formal-form.empty-test`        | `rule.test-fails-on-mutant`, `inv.no-empty-test`     | a test of `check.item.one-open-loan` written against a system that asserts nothing, beside the test that runs the check's trace                                                                                                                                                                                                    | `--mutate` runs                      | it names the test that asserts nothing as empty, not the one that runs the trace, and fails                                                                                                                                             | auto   |

## Trace

| Kind      | Term                   | ID                           | Type          | Definition                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| --------- | ---------------------- | ---------------------------- | ------------- | ------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------ |
| Entity    | Trace                  | `ent.trace`                  |               | A check's case as steps the oracle runs: the GIVEN and the WHEN as actions and days, the THEN as outcomes, notifications and assertions.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Relation  | Traces                 | `edge.trace.check`           | ref ent.check | The check whose case the trace runs.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Derived   | Surviving mutation     | `derived.surviving-mutation` |               | A change of one line of a formal form, a number by one, a comparison turned, and and or swapped, a not dropped, true and false swapped, that the forms still read and that no trace fails on; it is a case the catalogue does not hold, or a change that alters nothing, which the reviewer tells apart.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     |
| Concept   | Code adapter           | `concept.code-adapter`       |               | A project's module that calls each implemented action in the code, reads a refusal of the code as the row that refused it, and shows the code's state as records of the ontology, so that a trace runs on the code as on the oracle; it translates and hides nothing.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                        |
| Rule      | Trace runs on the code | `rule.trace-runs-on-code`    |               | Where the oracle is on, every traced check whose concepts, and the actions its trace takes, are all implemented is run on the code, through the adapter, by a test that names it; there it may differ from the oracle only in its THEN, for a check the adapter names with the ticket of a known divergence whose line names one of the check's concepts and with the failing lines of THEN that divergence accepts, and the words of a refusal are not compared: the kind of the outcome and the row that refused are, and a judged check judges the words. |
| Rule      | Test fails on a mutant | `rule.test-fails-on-mutant`  |               | A test of a check written against a system fails on the oracle with any change of one form that the check's trace fails on; one that passes there is empty.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |
| Invariant | Every check traced     | `inv.trace-per-check`        |               | When the oracle is on, every check of the catalogue has a trace, and every trace names a check of the catalogue. A check may instead have a line that says why it has none only when it sits in a section of views, is manual or covers the error outcome.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                   |
| Invariant | Traces pass            | `inv.traces-pass`            |               | Every trace holds on the oracle.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                             |
| Invariant | Traces run on the code | `inv.trace-run-on-code`      |               | Every check that rule.trace-runs-on-code asks for is run on a system by a test that a file of systemTests registers.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                         |
| Invariant | No empty test          | `inv.no-empty-test`          |               | With --mutate, no test of a check written against a system passes on a change of the forms that the check's trace fails on.                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                                  |

| Check                       | Concepts                                               | GIVEN                                                                                                                                                                                                            | WHEN           | THEN                                                                                                                                                                                                                                     | Proof |
| --------------------------- | ------------------------------------------------------ | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | -------------- | ---------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------------- | ----- |
| `check.trace.untraced`      | `inv.trace-per-check`, `ent.trace`, `edge.trace.check` | a check with no trace and no line that says why, and a trace that names no check of the catalogue                                                                                                                | the check runs | it names both and fails                                                                                                                                                                                                                  | auto  |
| `check.trace.fails`         | `inv.traces-pass`                                      | a trace whose THEN does not hold on the oracle                                                                                                                                                                   | `--run` runs   | it names the check and what differed, and exits 1                                                                                                                                                                                        | auto  |
| `check.trace.runs-on-code`  | `rule.trace-runs-on-code`, `inv.trace-run-on-code`     | the example, with its test of `check.item.one-open-loan` on the code taken out; then with every checkTest of the file in a comment; then without an adapter; then with an adapter that leaves out `action.renew` | the check runs | it names `check.item.one-open-loan`, then the traced checks with no adapter, then `action.renew`, and fails each time; a check whose trace takes `action.set-borrow-limit`, not built yet, is listed as information                      | auto  |
| `check.trace.code-diverges` | `rule.trace-runs-on-code`                              | the trace of a check run on a code that refuses nothing, on one that also breaks an assertion, on one that throws, and on the oracle                                                                             | the test runs  | it fails, unless the adapter names the check with the ticket of a known divergence whose line names one of its concepts and the effect it accepts covers every failing line of THEN; the broken assertion, the throw and the oracle fail | auto  |
